title: Launch notes orchestration, handoff runbook, and ops scripting
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: Create a repeatable orchestration and handoff runbook for drafting, gating, and publishing launch notes (internal changelog + customer-facing release note) so cross-functional stakeholders can run reviews, apply redaction rules, and publish with a single owner.

Scope: This ticket covers the playbook, templated snippets for multi-audience briefs (internal exec, engineering runbook, customer digest), a legal/PII redaction checklist, an automated Slack/GitHub notification script, and ops handoff steps for support & sales. It does NOT include content localization (handled by PM-74211) or final launch comms copywriting.

Deliverables:
- Single-threaded runbook (Google Doc link) with step-by-step gating and owner responsibilities.
- Three templates (internal exec brief, engineering incident-aware note, customer digest) as copy-ready Markdown.
- Redaction checklist and automated redaction flagging rules for callouts that require legal review.
- A lightweight script (OpsNotifier) to create a staged GitHub PR, open a Slack review thread in #launch-review, and ping support/sales on publish.
- Signoff matrix with SLAs for review (24h legal, 48h eng, 48h design for screenshots).

Acceptance criteria:
1) Runbook links to canonical artifacts (PRD, feature spec, dashboards) and shows explicit owners for each gate.
2) Templates can be consumed by PMs and localized with minimal edits.
3) Automated script exists as a documented runnable snippet (bash + GH CLI) and a GitHub Actions skeleton for future automation.
4) Redaction checklist covers PII, bounded customer examples, compliance flags, and legal owner contact.
5) At least two stakeholder reviews (Legal + Engineering) recorded as comments in this ticket before moving to Done.

Rollout timeline (compressed):
- 2026-02-17: Draft runbook + templates (owner: Jonah).
- 2026-02-19: Engineering review (eng reviewers: Ethan Wright, Priya Nair).
- 2026-02-21: Legal review and redaction pass (legal reviewers: Marina Lopez).
- 2026-02-23: Ops script demo and test publish to staging docs.
- 2026-02-24: Final signoff, handoff to comms & support for publish window 2026-03-02.

Known trade-offs / decisions:
- We are prioritizing a lightweight script and manual gating rather than full automation to preserve editorial review. Full automation (GH Actions publish) will be a follow-up (PM-50291).
- Localization is out of scope for this ticket to keep delivery small; templates are localization-ready though.
